SELECT t.id, t.task_name, t.task_status, t.status, t.remark, t.sort_order, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM task_algorithm WHERE task_id = t.id) AS algorithm_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT device_id) FROM task_device WHERE task_id = t.id) AS device_count, t.created_by, t.updated_by, t.created_at, t.updated_at FROM task t

SELECT t.id, t.task_name, t.task_status, t.status, t.remark, t.sort_order, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM task_algorithm WHERE task_id = t.id) AS algorithm_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT device_id) FROM task_device WHERE task_id = t.id) AS device_count, t.created_by, t.updated_by, t.created_at, t.updated_at FROM task t WHERE t.id = #{id} AND t.deleted = 0
